Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

priority.reason: Confirmed exploited (CISA KEV). EPSS 1% probability of exploitation within 30 days. CVSS v3 base score 9.9.

w5h.upgrade_action: Apply current vendor patches for Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator per the advisory (CISA remediation due date: 2026-10-26)
w5h.why_it_matters: This matters because exploitation is confirmed or actively occurring, not theoretical; critical severity means full compromise is likely if reached.

impact.affected_versions: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (specific versions not provided, assume all vulnerable until vendor clarifies)
impact.how_to_check: Inventory all Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator installations and compare versions against the advisory. Review logs on matching hosts for unusual authentication or administrative actions.
